concept: Firehose: managed stream delivery to S3/Redshift with batching, compression
tests: Choosing a service to deliver streaming data to S3 and Redshift without managing a stream.
expected: Amazon Data Firehose (Kinesis Data Firehose) — fully managed delivery with buffering, compression, transformation, no shards. Triggers: "deliver streaming data to S3 and Redshift", "automatic batching, compression", "no stream management".
why_not: Kinesis Data Streams — you manage shards and consumers; SQS — messaging; Glue streaming — ETL, not a delivery pipeline.
